resolved_conflicts.explanation: Firelookout.com and Idaho Fire Lookouts describe the 1934 cab on a 10-foot log crib. Kresek, as quoted on Forest Lookouts, says it sat atop a first floor of log cribbing. These describe the same structure and are presented together.

notes_for_editor: Three web pages and the Forest Fire Lookout Association list. The 1965 Post-Register item and the 1937 CCC item are quoted second-hand on the Weebly page; the original newspapers were not fetched. No source describes what remains at the site, so the story says so. Idaho Fire Lookouts has no documented staffing history; the 1942 last-used date comes from the 1965 article and is filed as other, not staffed. The Challis National Forest history compilation was searched but had no lookout entry for Cougar Creek. The access level public is inferred from forest land and the hike-in label. The brief's kind (two_story), L-4 design, 1967 destruction, and gone status are all supported.
